args: From the financial-coach project root, execute the monthly post-payday statement consolidation for the previous calendar month (in 'YYYY-MM' format, e.g., on October 15 target '2026-09' covering Sep 1 to Sep 30): (1) Invoke the 'statement-extractor' subagent 8 times in parallel (turns 1 through 8) for target month 'YYYY-MM' so each run inspects '.cache/statements/{AMEX,Barclays,Chase,HSBC}/*.pdf' across bank cut-off dates and writes '.cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM_[1..8].json'. (2) Semantically compare and merge all 8 extraction results ('YYYY-MM_1.json' .. 'YYYY-MM_8.json') into '.cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM.json', cross-checking any differing or candidate transactions against their 'transaction.source' PDF statement to ensure no rows are missed and every row genuinely exists, then delete the temporary 'YYYY-MM_[1..8].json' files. (3) Invoke the 'statement-classifier' subagent 4 times in parallel (turns 1 through 4) for target month 'YYYY-MM' to classify spending via 'merchantCategoryCode' ('bank-statement/mcc.ts') and generate 'aiReview' coaching commentary in '.cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM_classify_[1..4].json'. (4) Semantically merge the 4 classification and 'aiReview' outputs into the final '.cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM.json' and delete the temporary 'YYYY-MM_classify_[1..4].json' files. (5) Run './scripts/print-statement.sh YYYY-MM' to render 'https://finance.home.handy-david.dev/statements/YYYY-MM' and print it to '.cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM.pdf'. (6) Run './scripts/rclone.sh copy /data/statements/Consolidated gdrive:expense/Statements/Consolidated' to upload both 'YYYY-MM.json' and 'YYYY-MM.pdf' to Google Drive. Summarize the consolidated statement metrics and upload status.
description: On the 15th of every month at 10:00 AM (Europe/London), runs statement-extractor 8x and statement-classifier 4x with semantic merging to produce .cache/statements/Consolidated/YYYY-MM.json, prints https://finance.home.handy-david.dev/statements/YYYY-MM to YYYY-MM.pdf via ./scripts/print-statement.sh, and uploads both to Google Drive via ./scripts/rclone.sh.
